title: Recognize linked-worktree declared tests in an unbound live observation trace
outcome: An ordinary live observation trace without a cached binding can retain a local declared-only verdict from the independently reported linked execution location without granting proof or credit.
acceptance: An unbound traced opening whose runtime reports linked B retains the declared test and its verdict when session workdir A has no declaration.
No proof worktree, native reservation, attribution to a claim, or producer check is created.
